records.title: Stealing Training Data from Large Language Models in Decentralized Training through Activation Inversion Attack
records.reason: Studies activation-inversion attacks to recover training data from decentralized LLM training. It is a privacy/security attack against training, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Tomato, Tomahto, Tomate: Do Multilingual Language Models Understand Based on Subword-Level Semantic Concepts?
records.reason: Analyzes whether multilingual language models represent semantic concepts at the subword level. It is a capability/representation study, not a compression or serving method.

records.title: Bilingual Synchronization: Restoring Translational Relationships with Editing Operations
records.reason: Bilingual Synchronization uses editing operations to restore translation relations in bilingual sequence generation. It is an NAR/translation decoding approach, but the paper’s contribution is translation quality rather than a demonstrated inference-efficiency gain.

records.title: A Call for Collaborative Intelligence: Why Human-Agent Systems Should Precede AI Autonomy
records.reason: This position paper argues for collaborative human-agent systems before full autonomy. It discusses deployment roles and risks, not model inference optimization.
